receipt_commit_note: This regenerated receipt is committed separately after the tested fix commit; its own SHA is available in git log.
shared_hook: Small additive opt-in intent_base_policy() discovery in v2v_intent.intent_model. Arbitrary nn.Module objects remain opaque; existing non-module wrapper lookup and direct IntentPolicy discovery retain their behavior.

blockers_fixed.issue: Shared global RSU latent reached each trigger distribution
blockers_fixed.fix: TriggerPolicy._hidden uses only the ego x/V2V row and a constant zero ACTOR_LATENT tail through the existing actor trunk. It neither reads context.rsu nor calls broadcast. Trigger value shares the same local-only features. Explicit fine-tuning excludes all broadcast parameters. Base forward/sample/score remain delegated unchanged.
blockers_fixed.regression: Real acceleration.encode with ego/peer at -400/-380 m and distant HDV at 0 m, nonzero loaded broadcast and partner input columns. Changing only distant HDV speed 5 to 25 changes base actions but leaves trigger probabilities, values, sampled actions and logp exactly equal. Removing rsu entirely is supported. Local sensed speed and legitimate recorded V2V changes remain usable, with no cross-ego pooling. Tested frozen and fine-tuned modes.

blockers_fixed.issue: IntentPolicy hidden by nn.Module wrapper caused 24/48-wide controller mismatch
blockers_fixed.fix: TriggerPolicy.intent_base_policy() opts into the shared intent discovery hook, so the existing V2V controller obtains the underlying IntentPolicy, builds 48-wide intent blocks and publishes that policy's intents.
blockers_fixed.regression: Actual controller_class(acceleration.Controller) with TriggerPolicy(IntentPolicy) versus the unwrapped base at ticks 301, 302 and 304, in both deterministic and stochastic modes. Exact request/sample/action/logp/value/noise-memory/generator-state/intent-board parity; 48-wide blocks; first-tick invalid intents; second-tick partner t-1 values; skipped-tick stale invalidation; current publication checked against the base head. Separate discovery case preserves arbitrary-module opacity and plain V2V non-intent behavior.

api.construction: TriggerPolicy(loaded_v2v_policy, v2v_dim=48, n_candidates=<registered budget>, partner_slots=5, freeze_base=True, moves_api=None). Supports V2V-only width 24; width must match the loaded actor. moves_api=None lazily imports tools.coopmwm.moves. CPU only; attachment preserves global torch RNG.
api.base_policy: forward(context), sample(...), score(sample) delegate unchanged. Frozen trigger updates preserve every base tensor and sampled actions/noise. Low-level actor retains its existing inputs independently of the local-only trigger feature path.
api.trigger_features: Per-member x (29 sensor values plus configured V2V width), constant four-wide zero latent, loaded per-CAV actor trunk, candidate descriptors. No global RSU, broadcast or pooled critic input. Caller must supply causal locally sensed and timestamped V2V payloads.
api.intent_adapter: intent_base_policy() -> base_policy; v2v_intent.intent_model follows this explicit nn.Module hook. Existing controller_class(Controller) can receive TriggerPolicy(IntentPolicy(...)) directly.
api.decide: policy.decide(context, obs_states={ego: local_observable_state}, observable_cavs={ego: ordered_local_CAV_ids_including_ego}, rng=numpy_rng, generator=torch_cpu_generator, deterministic=False) -> TriggerBatch. Caller owns registered cadence; candidates drawn once per ego.
api.discrete_actions: 0=none; 1..N=family/partners/parameter candidate bucket. Family one-hot, observable partner membership and onset/hold/depth normalized using VARIETY_REGISTERED; unavailable slots masked.
api.move_contract: moves.FAMILIES includes none; candidates(obs_state, rng, n) returns objects/mappings with family, members, onset_s, hold_s, depth; offsets(move, elapsed_s) returns member acceleration offsets. Non-none moves require 1..4 unique observable CAV members including ego and registered parameter ranges.
api.rollout: TriggerBatch records deep-copied context/tables, descriptors/mask, actions and detached old logp/values. selected() -> {ego: Move_or_None}; evaluate(batch) -> per-CAV logp, value, entropy. PPO replay never draws new candidates.
api.optimizer: optimizer(lr=...) owns exactly learning_parameters(). Frozen: trigger score/value heads only. freeze_base=False: additionally actor parameters, never broadcast/critic/intent_head/log_std. Pre-r1 fine-tuned optimizer states containing broadcast parameters must be rebuilt with the corrected ownership; collect fresh trigger rollouts under the corrected feature path.
api.ppo_update: ppo_update(policy, optimizer, batch, advantages, returns, clip_ratio=..., value_weight=..., entropy_weight=..., max_grad_norm=...) -> loss, policy_loss, value_loss, entropy, approx_kl, clip_fraction, grad_norm, cav_count. One clipped minibatch step; caller owns GAE/epochs/KL budget. No silent advantage normalization.
api.imitation: imitation_loss(batch, target_action_indices) -> masked-table cross entropy; targets index the recorded table.
api.checkpoint: Standard state_dict/load_state_dict(strict=True), corrected optimizer state_dict and CPU generator state. Reconstruct identical constructor settings, family ordering and variety registration; next-step optimizer parity covered by tests.
api.execution_start: MoveExecutor(moves_api=None).start(move, ego=..., observable_cav_ids=..., now=..., until=...) -> bool. Explicit commitment expiry; none abstains; overlapping member sets rejected atomically.
api.execution_requests: requests(base_actions, native_commands, now=..., eligible_cav_ids=..., feasible_bounds=...) -> request overlay with requested_raw and acceleration_residual. Offsets compose on absolute MAPPO actions, clamp to observable feasibility bounds and the 1.2 m/s^2 CAV cap. No HDV/departed/ineligible command; unaffected requests unchanged.
api.integration: Merge executor overlay before existing feasibility/CommandOwnership single-writer routing and retain speedMode 27. T2C supplies causal local states, identities, cadence, bounds, eligibility and commitment expiry. No TraCI calls in this module. No WM horizon changes or B/R-specific behavior.
